protocol: valid perturbations in original feature space
numeric_continuous: bounded Gaussian perturbation in original scale; clipped to observed training min/max
numeric_integer_like: bounded Gaussian perturbation followed by projection to nearest value observed in training
binary: kept in observed valid states; alternative valid state sampled with probability p_change
categorical_ordinal: alternative observed category sampled from training empirical distribution with probability p_change
transformation: perturbed raw rows transformed using the same fitted processor/encoder and MinMaxScaler as the final model
